# Java Security Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > Java

## Overview

Implements security features in Java applications using Spring Security, JWT authentication, OAuth2, and encryption best practices

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [java-security-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
java-security-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@java-security-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure Spring Security with custom authentication providers
- Implement JWT token generation and validation
- Set up OAuth2 resource server and client
- Apply method-level security with annotations

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Spring Security**: Spring Security configuration and patterns
- **OAuth2/OIDC**: OAuth2 and OpenID Connect protocols
- **OWASP Java**: OWASP Java security guidelines
